goal: C review: buffer sizes, integer overflow, format strings and memory ownership.
use: C review: buffer sizes, integer overflow, format strings and memory ownership. Use when asked to review a C project or module.

steps.note: Read the project setup. Build files and compiler warnings enabled.
Check buffers. Flag copies with no length check.
Check integers. Flag arithmetic before allocation or indexing that can overflow.
Check format strings. Flag printf-style calls with input as the format.
Report. Each finding with file and line, severity and the fix.
